items.title: Narrow breadth cushioned by positive dealer gamma into a calm pre-close
items.note: Market breadth has slipped below its broad-market threshold (heatmap 56.47% positive vs 60%, margin -3.53, narrow leadership) at the same time SPY dealer gamma is positive (signedNetGEX +$5.99B, spot 773.16 above the 770.65 flip, call wall 775 / put wall 770) and the pre-close intraday tape is a two-sided Mixed / developing auction (VWAP 772.69). Thinning participation is meeting a pinning, move-dampening dealer structure while the bench still reads bull-stacked (SPY 773.12, +10.17% vs 200d) and the regime is calm (band 'VIX 14.6', VIX 14.57, score 1). Structurally this is a pin-cage over fragile internals — narrow leadership whose downside is temporarily muffled by positive gamma rather than a broad, healthy advance. It is an emergent cross-tool divergence, not any single owner read; the cushion lapses and the read flips to break-watch if spot loses the 770.65 flip.
items.method: Cross-tool divergence flag: compare market-heatmap-lab breadthPct against its own 60% broad threshold (sign of the margin), then overlay the options-structure / gamma-trading dealer-gamma sign together with spot-versus-flip position and the intraday-tape session type. Raise the pattern only when breadth is below threshold AND dealer gamma is positive AND spot sits above the flip (pinning), all against a calm VIX band and a bull-stacked bench — flagging a suppressed-volatility cushion over narrow internals, and inverting to break-watch once spot falls below the flip.
inputs: market-heatmap-lab: breadthPct 56.47, threshold 60, margin -3.53, 134 constituents, leadership narrow
options-structure-lab: signedNetGEX 5992333641.8636, flipLevel 770.65, spot 773.16, callWall 775, putWall 770, expectedMove 3.07
gamma-trading-lab: regime positive, scenario pin-to-maxpain, conviction patient, flip 770.65
intraday-tape-lab: sessionType 'Mixed / developing', control Algo-controlled, vwap 772.69, gapPct 0.55
regime band 'VIX 14.6' (vix 14.57, score 1); bench SPY 773.12 bull-stack (+3.4% vs 50d, +10.17% vs 200d)

items.title: Two-horizon technology concentration as market breadth thins
items.note: Leadership is concentrating into technology across two independent horizons even as broad participation narrows: the short-horizon sector RRG rotates into XLK (Leading quad, rsMom6m +20.73) while the long-horizon 6M ETF-momentum ranking is led by VGT at 30.48% with QQQ also in the top five — both technology-tilted — at the same time market-heatmap breadth sits below its 60% threshold (56.47%, margin -3.53). Two methods that do not share code agree the tape is being carried by tech, and the sub-threshold breadth says fewer names are along for the ride. That combination — cross-horizon tech leadership plus thinning breadth — is a concentration signal rather than a broadening one, and it raises single-sector fragility if the tech bid stalls.
items.method: Cross-horizon concentration check: intersect the sector-research-lab rotation target (into-ticker with its RRG quad and rsMom6m) with the etf-momentum-lab 6M leader and top-five membership, then gate on market-heatmap-lab breadth being below its broad threshold. Raise the pattern only when the short-horizon sector rotation and the long-horizon momentum leader point at the same theme (technology here) AND breadth is sub-threshold, marking leadership as concentrating rather than broadening.
inputs: sector-research-lab: into XLK, rrgState 'Leading', rsRatio 100.02, rsMom 103.57, rsMom6m 20.73, accel 5.75
etf-momentum-lab: leader VGT signal 30.48, horizon 6M, risk balanced; QQQ in top five (signal 18.81)
market-heatmap-lab: breadthPct 56.47, threshold 60, margin -3.53, leadership narrow
regime band 'VIX 14.6' (vix 14.57, score 1); bench SPY 773.12 bull-stack
